observation_cutoff: Explicit timezone-aware caller input; separate from historical cutoff
source_evidence_only_case: 1340; PDF retained, no automatic numerical fact extraction
display_policy: Exact raw replay + semantics PASS + observation <= cutoff permits labelled nondecision display; Historical PIT and latest remain UNPROVEN
quarantine_policy: Invalid receipt/raw/semantics records retain failure identity/reason, no verified numerical display
unknown_policy: Null and UNPROVEN remain unknown; no substitution or coverage
version_policy: Append-only new output directories; retain observation records, no overwrite or latest claim
duration_policy: QUARTER/YEAR_TO_DATE/ANNUAL and BASIC/DILUTED are independent facts, never merged or differenced
day_only_policy: Unapproved proposal only; existing SECOND-only PIT selector unchanged
reproducibility: Exact pinned source + same observation_cutoff + same implementation bytes => identical core/core_sha256; generated_at/code_sha are explicit envelope provenance
output_policy: New child of external rate-eps-b1-research root only; resolved containment, repository/protected namespace, symlink/junction and overwrite guards
